_readme: Every piece of text, every number, every link on the site comes from here. Nothing else needs touching. You can edit all of it without opening this file: sign in at the editor URL (kept in the CMS_PATH environment variable) and click any text or picture on the live site. Pictures can also be replaced by dropping a new file in /public/images and pointing the path here at it. After editing run `npm run dev` to preview, or push to deploy.

meta.title: Strategic Operations & GTM
meta.description: I turn ambiguity into traction — GTM strategy, operations and partnerships.

cases.title: $60k Raised. 16 Months. 4 Borders. Zero Margin for Error.
cases.detail: When Afghanistan's collapse cut off every standard channel out of the country overnight, no embassies, no banking access, no precedent, I led an independent evacuation operation from zero. I led a coalition across Harvard and the University of British Columbia networks, retained immigration lawyers across four countries, and negotiated directly with diplomatic and political officials through constantly shifting policy, rerouting in real time whenever a path closed. The operation succeeded with $60,000 raised and zero margin for error, leading to a family's safety and relocation in North America. The experience later led to a keynote at Harvard on leadership in crisis.

cases.title: 4 Months. Zero Pipeline. First Place.
cases.detail: An early-stage AI infrastructure startup had a strong technical product and zero go-to-market motion. I identified target buyers, built the positioning, and worked directly with the founder and engineering team to translate deep technical work into language operators, partners, and investors could act on. In four months, we secured the company's first partnership, its first grant, and won 1st Prize at Montreal Tech Week, the earliest proof points that turn a strong product into a fundable company.

cases.title: 1 Rebrand. 1 Roadmap. Market Visibility Restored.
cases.detail: A solo-founder consultancy had real differentiation, hands-on accountability most competitors couldn't match, but none of it showed up in how the market saw the business. I rebuilt the value proposition and messaging from the ground up, restructured the website and digital storytelling, and built a phased visibility roadmap across press, podcasts, and AI search optimization. The result: a brand whose market presence finally matched what made it worth choosing.

cases.title: 200+ Customer Discovery Interviews. 10+ Investor Pitches.
cases.detail: A healthtech idea addressing blood glucose spikes had a real problem but no validated path to market. I ran 200+ customer discovery interviews, converted the findings into a B2B/B2C go-to-market strategy, and closed clinical and vendor partnerships in a highly regulated category, while building the financial model and pitching at demo day.

hero.headline: I turn ambiguity into traction through persistence, work, and partnerships.
body: Operating in environments with high uncertainty requires a specific mindset: the ability to process complex variables, identify the critical path, and execute without waiting for perfect information.

Whether it's structuring a 0-to-1 go-to-market plan, leading cross-functional teams under pressure, or securing vital early-stage capital, my focus is always on building the system that makes the outcome repeatable.
